name: ATM Configuration Control Component 1
definition: Information related to the control of a configuration on ATM device.

ConfigurationVersion.name: Configuration Version
ConfigurationVersion.definition: The configuration version which is being sent to the terminal.

ActionRequired.name: Action Required
ActionRequired.definition: The action which is required by the terminal on receipt of this configuration update. This will be one of: APLY (Apply) apply the configuration update, or NONE no configuration to be applied.

Property.name: Property
Property.definition: Set of properties related to an ATM configuration.

ActivationDate.name: Activation Date
ActivationDate.definition: Date when the whole configuration is to be activated. If no activation date is provided, the activation must occur immediately.
